cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Impossible Currency
cards.instruction: Price every favor in symbolic acts, imaginary resources, or promises that cannot be measured normally.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Borrow my ladder for one shadow until Friday.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need my shadow at work.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Keep its office hours. I'll take its evenings.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you hold the ladder too? I'm afraid of heights.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For that, leave me your fear of falling. I'll keep it until you're down; you can climb without it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For a wedding cake, we weigh the flour. Please put that mug down.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's quicker. I've used three mugs already.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: All right. Show me the mug, and I'll weigh one mugful.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I used three different mugs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Please fetch all three. Apparently we're measuring the crockery before we can measure the flour.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm tuning this piano. Please leave the keys alone while I listen.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm checking the sticky ones so you can fix those too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you. Mark them with these little stickers. Silently, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Done. Shall I peel them off so you can play?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One at a time. After I reach each key. We've nearly invented a system.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Borrow my ladder for one shadow until Friday.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need my shadow at work.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep its office hours. I'll take its evenings.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you hold the ladder too? I'm afraid of heights.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For that, leave me your fear of falling. I'll keep it until you're down; you can climb without it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll fix the kettle for a spoonful of yesterday.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How do I give you yesterday?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Start with the five minutes you wasted this morning.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's today.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then leave it overnight. I can wait for the currency to mature.

cards.instruction: Agree completely, then redefine each term using rules that make your preferred outcome inevitable.

cards.title: The Logic Gets Bigger
cards.instruction: Use every new detail to expand the impossible system, its history, and the consequences of breaking it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Our meeting chairs float at noon. Book the ceiling; they've had landing rights since the first furniture strike.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can't we stand and tie the chairs down?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Restraint broke the last treaty. That's when the desks joined them. We'll need an airspace permit.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The caretaker only issues floor permits.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then promote her to altitude minister before the cabinets claim the roof.

cards.title: Co-Sign This
cards.instruction: Get someone to help by making them an official participant who shares responsibility for the outcome.

beats.speaker: B

beats.text: The owner wants a replacement by Sunday if it breaks.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you're co-chair of replacements too. I'll call the shops; you approve what we buy before either of us promises her anything.

beats.text: Done. Shall I peel them off so you can play?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One at a time. After I reach each key. We've nearly invented a system.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you leave tonight's book club, we close the discussion together.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I said goodnight. My taxi's coming.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll say 'chapter closed'; you answer 'until next time.' Then we can leave.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's here. I'll say my bit from the car.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll come to your window. Give me ten seconds of your taxi time; I only need you through 'until next time.'

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you hand in your shop keys, we do the farewell bell.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm leaving because the bell rings constantly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Precisely. This is the last one you have to answer.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine. Ring it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We ring it together. Leaving is still a team activity.
